content.snl: variable(__list__(Type.annotation(@$\mathbb{K}$,Type),Type.annotation(@V,Type),LA.Field($\mathbb{K}$),LA.VectorSpace(V,$\mathbb{K}$),Type.annotation(@x,V),Type.annotation(@y,V),Type.annotation(@hIP,InnerProductSpace($\mathbb{K}$,V))),def(inner(x,y),,$\langle x,y\rangle : V \times V \to \mathbb{K} \quad \text{(conjugate-symmetric, conjugate-linear in } x \text{, positive definite)}$))

values.zh-CN: $\langle x,y\rangle$ 是 $x,y$ 的内积：映射 $V\times V\to\mathbb{K}$，满足共轭对称、对第一变量共轭线性与正定性。Lean 中 `inner 𝕜 x y` 的标量域 $\mathbb{K}$ 是显式参数。
values.en: $\langle x,y\rangle$ is the inner product of $x,y$: a map $V\times V\to\mathbb{K}$ that is conjugate-symmetric, conjugate-linear in the first argument, and positive definite. In Lean `inner 𝕜 x y` takes the scalar field $\mathbb{K}$ explicitly.
